Fields.Name: Animation ID
Fields.Description: The animation ID within a category (3000 for a000_003000). With an offset type other than None, the game adds the category at runtime, so the same ID can play from several time acts.

Fields.Name: Is Base Pose Animation
Fields.Description: Nightreign only. True on almost every Nightreign selector (181,075 of 182,959 in the game files). Elden Ring files don't have this field.
